newsitem.title: CANADA: BCE acquires 10.3-pct stake in Sun Media.
newsitem.headline: BCE acquires 10.3-pct stake in Sun Media.

text.p: Sun Media Inc, a privately-held company that controls 100 percent of the shares of Sun Media Corp, said on Friday BCE Media Investments, a division of BCE Inc, purchased CIBC Wood Gundy Capital Ltd's interest in Sun Media and is now a 10.3-percent shareholder in the company.
In a separate deal, BCE Media Investments also acquired a 40-percent interest in CANOE (Canadian Online Explorer), the new media division of Sun Media.
Financial details of the deals were not disclosed.
CIBC Woody Gundy is the brokerage arm of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.
"We've been blessed all along with an exceptionally strong and committed group of investors," said Sun Media president and chief executive Paul Godfrey. "We welcome BCE to this group."
Godfrey led a C$411 million management buyout of the former Toronto Sun Publishing Corp, completed in October 1996.
